public_gates: design a current-hidden recovery anchor without cross-checkpoint hidden leakage

forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M277

success_criteria: define a recovery-anchor contract that avoids cross-checkpoint hidden leakage

commands.name: m277_design
commands.command: Design current-hidden terminal-margin recovery anchors before any new learning step.

decision_rule: M277 should not train. It should produce a recovery-anchor design that can be implemented before any new actor update or PPO.
